Name: Pokemon Retextures
Author: irowirow
Description:
[u]@UPDATE! 16/08/2017
[/u][size=2]
I recently got back into the game and decided to give a little bit of polishing to my mods.[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Removed dark borders from all Pokémon.[/size]
[*][size=2]Added new animations for Glameow, Meganium and Vaporeon.[/size]
[*][size=2]Added a little pokeball to the back of the Team Rocket Shirt.[/size]
[*][size=2]Added Blue Chicken.[/size]
[*][size=2]Changed Void Chicken.[/size]
[*][size=2]Changed White Chicken.[/size]
[/list]
[b][u][size=3]@ Changes the following animals to Pokémon:[/size][/u][/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]Baby Brown Cow - Numel[/size]
[*][size=2]Baby Pig - Swinub[/size]
[*][size=2]Baby Rabbit - Swirlix[/size]
[*][size=2]Baby White Cow - Miltank[/size]
[*][size=2]Blue Chicken - Taillow[/size]
[*][size=2]Brown Chicken - Pidgey[/size]
[*][size=2]Brown Cow - Camerupt[/size]
[*][size=2]Cat - Glameow[/size]
[*][size=2]Dinosaur - Shieldon[/size]
[*][size=2]Dog - Vaporeon[/size]
[*][size=2]Horse - Meganium[/size]
[*][size=2]Pig - Piloswine[/size]
[*][size=2]Rabbit - Swirlix[/size]
[*][size=2]Void Chicken - Murkrow[/size]
[*][size=2]White Chicken - Rufflet[/size]
[*][size=2]White Cow - Miltank[/size]
[/list][u]
[b][size=3]@ Changes the Cursors.xnb file to include a Vaporeon/Glameow/Meganium head next to your dog/cat/horse names in the menu.

@ Changes Krobus to Duskull.[/size][/b][/u][size=3]

[/size][b][u][size=3]@ Changes the Joja shirt (Shirt 106) and the Good Ol' Cap to a Team Rocket Grunt Outfit.[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Get the Grey Shoe [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/330/?]here[/url].[/size]
[/list][/u][/b]
[b][u][size=3]@ How to install:[/size][/u][/b]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Download and extract the file.[/size]

[*][size=3]Put the [b]files[/b] in your [b]Stardew Valley/Content/ [/b]folder and overwrite the original files (make a backup first!).[/size]

[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size]

[/list]

[size=3]You can find more pokemon retextures [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/pokemon-retextures-list.111179/]HERE[/url].
[/size][size=3]
Check out my other mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/330/?]HERE[/url][/size].

[size=3]If you find any bugs/strange sprites feel free to contact me![/size]
